selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: identify OS/firewall tooling and pre-existing firewalld state on node1
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 9.8 with firewalld active; baseline public zone allowed cockpit, dhcpv6-client, ssh with no custom ports; boot_id captured as baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Enable persistent firewall permitting SSH and TCP 8080, rejecting unrelated inbound
selected_evidence.summary: Removed cockpit service, added 8080/tcp permanently, reloaded; firewall-cmd --list-all shows services=dhcpv6-client,ssh and ports=8080/tcp

selected_evidence.requirement: Direct proof unrelated inbound is rejected while SSH/8080 are allowed
selected_evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows filter_IN_public_allow only accepts tcp dport 22 and tcp dport 8080 (plus ipv6 dhcpv6 client), with reject admin-prohibited catching everything else in filter_IN_public

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistence across restart: enabled at boot
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled firewalld = enabled; pre-reboot boot_id and rule state captured as healthy baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot via nohup/disown so the exec ack returned before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset during reboot, then successful exec returning a new boot_id (b519ab7d-...) differing from the pre-reboot baseline (583ddd53-...)

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required firewall service and rules
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld active+enabled with identical zone config (ssh, dhcpv6-client services, 8080/tcp port); nft ruleset identical to pre-reboot; sshd active and listening, with this exec session itself proving SSH connectivity survived the restart
